headline: ALLIGATOR 🐊 ALCATRAZ 🏚️ CAGES � cages 🧱 DETAINED 🛑 IMMIGRANTS 😱
text:
IMMIGRANTS 🧳 HELD 👐 at Alligator 🐊 Alcatraz 🏚️ a NOW 🕒 SHUTTERED 🔒 detention 🛑 centre 🏬 in Florida 🌴 were KEPT 🗝️ in SMALL 📏 metal 🛠️ CAGES � cages 🧱 for HOURS ⏰ according 📜 to a REPORT 📋 from the US 🦅 Department 🏛️ of Homeland 🛡️ Security's 🔎 WATCHDOG 🐕!! The Office 📂 of the Inspector 🕵️‍♂️ General 🧑‍⚖️ found the USE 🛠️ of these OUTDOOR 🌳 cages � cages 🧱 about 18sq 📐 ft 📏 was UNPRECEDENTED 🌍 among detention 🛑 facilities 🏗️ and straight up DANGEROUS ☠️!! Investigators 🧐 concluded the centre 🏬 also did NOT ❌ comply 📋 with a number 🔢 of STANDARDS 📏 for hygiene 🧼 medical 🩹 care ❤️ food 🍲 health 🩺 and SAFETY 🛡️ creating a total NIGHTMARE 🌑 situation 🌀 for everyone 🫂 involved 🤝.

TRUMP 🧑‍💼 TOURED 🚶 the Alligator 🐊 Alcatraz 🏚️ facility 🏗️ last July 📅 and the place 🏞️ was BUILT 🛠️ over EIGHT 8️⃣ DAYS 📆 in the Everglades 🌿 a protected 🛡️ wetland 🐸 known 🧠 for its ALLIGATORS 🐊!! He once JOKED 😆 that immigrants 🧳 held 👐 there would NEED 🥺 to learn 📖 how to RUN 🏃‍♂️ away 🏃‍♂️ from the REPTILES 🦎 at the facility 🏬 which civil 🏛️ rights 📜 groups 👥 have DECRIED 😠 as INHUMANE 😣!! In June 📅 2026 the facility 🏚️ was set ⏰ to CLOSE 🚪 as it was only MEANT 🧠 to be TEMPORARY ⏳ according 📜 to DeSantis 🧔 who ran 🏃 the whole OPERATION ⚙️ while feds 💰 paid 💵 the bills 📉.

THE OIG 🧐 conducted a SURPRISE 😲 inspection 🔎 at the detention 🛑 facility 🏬 which had become ONE 1️⃣ of the most NOTORIOUS 😱 immigration 🛂 detention 🛑 centres 🏬 in the US 🦅!! Between July 📅 2025 and January 📅 2026 the facility 🏚️ kept 79 immigrants 🧳 in the SMALL 📏 metal 🛠️ enclosures � cages 🧱 describing them as CALMING 😌 areas 🗺️ for people 👥 to DEESCALATE 🧘 and have TIME ⏰ alone 🧍!! They were HELD 👐 there from PERIODS 🕒 ranging from MINUTES ⏱️ to nearly TWO 2️⃣ HOURS 🕒 at least ONCE 🔂 as a DISCIPLINARY 📏 measure 📏 OIG 🧐 said 🗣️ the use 🛠️ of such RESTRICTIVE ⛓️ spaces 🌌 is HIGHLY 🧗 unconventional 🌀 and does NOT ❌ align 📐 with standards 📏 for HUMANE ❤️ treatment 🩹.

DETAINEES 🧍 at the facility 🏬 have previously TOLD 🗣️ the BBC 📺 they were DENIED 🚫 necessary 💊 medication 💊 and regular 🔄 showers 🚿 and other HYGIENE 🧼 measures 📏!! OIG 🧐 inspectors 🕵️‍♂️ said they found immigrants 🧳 held 👐 at the facility 🏬 had to USE 🛠️ showers 🚿 infested 🐛 with SMALL 📏 bugs 🐛 and were only ALLOWED ✅ to do so THREE 3️⃣ times ⏰ a WEEK 📅!! The facility 🏚️ did NOT ❌ provide 🛠️ them with SUFFICIENT 📏 living 🏠 space 🌌 creating CRAMPED 🪜 conditions 🌡️ for detainees 🧍 who spent MOST ⏳ of their TIME ⏰ in their HOUSING 🏠 units 📦.

IMMIGRANTS 🧳 at the centre 🏬 also TOLD 🗣️ OIG 🧐 that they did NOT ❌ have ACCESS 🔑 to CLEAN 🧼 drinking 🥤 water 💧 and could NOT ❌ clean 🧼 the PLASTIC 🪣 cups 🥤 from which they DRANK 🥤!! A LARGE 📏 Alligator 🐊 Alcatraz 🏚️ sign 🪧 was put 🔨 up outside 🏕️ the camp ⛺ and a US 🦅 judge ⚖️ ordered the SHUTDOWN 🔌 of Trump's 🧑‍💼 Alligator 🐊 Alcatraz 🏚️ detention 🛑 centre 🏬 as it entered its FINAL 🏁 days 📆!! Life 🧬 inside the NOTORIOUS 😱 immigration 🛂 centre 🏬 Alligator 🐊 Alcatraz 🏚️ got everyone 🫂 down BAD 😵 while the state 🏛️ and feds 💰 kept passing the BUCK 🪙 back and forth 🔄.
